title: The Council: nodes and states
description: Implementation planning diagrams for the approved Council design. They show proposed software, not a deployed system.

diagrams.title: Council component nodes
diagrams.description: The calling agent authors candidates. The state machine selects transitions. Orca owns worker lifecycle.
diagrams.accessibility: Three equal reviewers and one fresh judge connect through an Orca adapter to a deterministic controller and its journal.

diagrams.title: Council control states
diagrams.description: Normative 17-state contract. New runs start at preflight; restoreForReconciliation externally selects reconciling before effects. Guards on saved phase/target make return edges mutually exclusive.
diagrams.accessibility: Up to two shared clarification waves precede three deliberation rounds. Human wait occurs only with settled resources. Every answer is shared. Unknown lifecycle remains in reconciliation.
